display_name: Assessment of organizational, administrative and accounting arrangements

classes.purpose: Assess company arrangements, operating evidence, proportionate findings, actions and prior reviews
classes.content: Selected company descriptions, organization charts, staff roles and delegations, procedures, interview notes, minutes, management/accounting reports, forecasts, operating examples, prior reviews, action evidence and professional decisions. Initial assessment, source review, action planning and subsequent review may read complete relevant files and prior records. There is no fixed excerpt limit or automatic anonymization. Local Python verifies source bindings and hashes and renders records; it does not perform semantic assessment. Targeted questions and attributed answers, conflicting accounts, process/risk/control relationships and event-versus-information chronology may enter the same model context. The model revises hypotheses and writes a management discussion brief; the helper only validates linked records and renders them. Construction can also read original interview Markdown, corrected transcripts supplied by the user, methodology catalog, qualified evidence, numerical explanations, attributed professional overrides, control designs, manuals and registers, company adoption evidence, execution samples, strategy objectives, KPI definitions and observations, and exact linked Business Planning or externally reviewed artifacts. The standalone HTML form makes no network requests, captures no audio and exports drafts only on explicit user action. Returning that draft to Codex or Cowork brings its contents into the selected model context. Local actor labels are attribution and are not authenticated professional identities. No hosted audio adapter or automatic upload is included.

classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested
classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Discuss one explicitly selected prepared assessment section without substituting a complete client folder
classes.content: One exact current producer assessment, observation, finding, proposed action, prior-action review, coverage, process, question, chronology, decision brief, next-review or recorded decision section. Explicit authored ID links may include related observations, findings, actions and cited source metadata. Professional company descriptions, assessments, attributed roles, dates, uncertainties and citations can enter the selected runtime model context. The complete selected explanation is limited to 64000 serialized bytes without truncation, and stale revisions are refused; full files and complete record are not substituted. Native private decision drafts, confirmation and panel history stay app-private and are not explanation context. This is not anonymization or verification of source truth, actual operating effectiveness, identity or adequacy. Other ordinary specialist routes may still read relevant complete files.

classes.purpose: Author a new complete assessment from the exact user-chosen running Archive inputs
classes.content: The literal professional question and all explicitly selected original paths, complete byte hashes and import/upstream receipts can enter the current Codex chat through an opaque actor/tenant/client/engagement/run-bound grant. Metadata above 100 KB is refused without sampling. The model may read the selected original files completely, together with company facts, staff roles, interviews, policies, operating examples, conflicting accounts, prior sealed assessments, every prior action, targeted questions and answers. There is no file-content excerpt cap, anonymization or local-only promise. The same-chat handoff or its copyable fallback supplies exact mandate references. Complete model-authored review, intelligent_review, record and memo are privately staged for explicit user conservation. Draft question/source fields and private panel confirmations do not confer model access before the mandate. Semantic scope, proportionality, source qualification and interpretation remain model-led; conservation does not establish adequacy, adoption, effectiveness or professional approval. The selected account arrangement applies; Vera is not a separate recipient. A selected original vera.user_statement.v1 interview source can include complete literal notes, optional unverified speaker, configured actor/tenant/client/engagement references and actual collection time. Collection time is not historical fact or information availability; reported practice and missing independent operating evidence remain separately qualified.

external_boundaries.destination: Current primary and professional public sources selected for the case
external_boundaries.purpose: Verify the current source basis for legal and professional proposals
external_boundaries.content: Legal or professional research topics, public-source queries and selected source URLs; direct client identifiers are not used in the public research route
controls: Record retrieval, version, temporal scope, and reuse status for selected sources.
Keep credentials, authentication codes, cookies, screening-provider tokens, and direct client identifiers out of public research.

external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow
external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.

security_controls.control: The CLI requires a running portable v2 adeguati-assetti archive context and checks selected source paths against exact run receipts before reading them.
Records bind source hashes, prior client and engagement identity, and exact proposal digests for decisions; content-addressed output never overwrites an earlier record.

The construction CLI validates exact archive receipts and source bytes, rejects cross-client snapshots, uses transactional compare-and-append revisions and idempotency keys, validates intake identity/version, and binds decisions and manual versions to exact dependencies. Offline HTML escapes case data, uses a no-network CSP and has no automatic upload or microphone access.

Only the fixed assetti producer and same running reviewer-owned registered run are accepted. Signed source scopes, exact byte receipts and actor/tenant/client/engagement/run/implementation-bound grants refuse foreign or changed inputs. Private CAS stages require the current intelligent_review extension and reject model professional_decision. A predecessor must be the exact sealed same-engagement assetti artifact in a fresh run. Signed explicit selected conservation uses the unchanged immutable public producer; completed request receipts replay exact retries and pending/orphaned/changed/unreceipted work blocks further authoring, professional decisions and all-output closure until recovery.
